title: PR-body deferrals are claimed recorded in deferred-work.md but were never written
evidence:
Deferred (deferred-work.md): the loop→feed_drop_sites call-site pin (the
pre-existing debug_surface_smoke.sh class — needs a headless app-drive
harness); SLA text draw-path pixel pin (app package not harness-
importable; folds into the same story).
detail: _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md holds only two older entries (3.2 lane QoS, routing-bandwidth-cost; last touched by commit 32a1b65, pre-dating this job) — the two claimed gauge deferrals were never appended, so this known debt is untracked.

title: Chunk-ghost draw block duplicated across the two bar gauges
detail: Identical ghost geometry/alpha math lives in two files; a future cue-craft change (blend rule, band calculation) must be made twice and can silently diverge between the bars — the same drift risk pool_fill_pct/sla_avg_ms were extracted to kill.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared render helper (e.g. draw_chunk_ghost(v, g, raw_pct, col, bar_x, bar_y, bar_w, bar_h)) and call it from both bars.

title: gauge_test.odin header still says 'roster > 8' after the 8→16 slot bump
evidence:
(h) FEED (gauge_tick) — health/pool/sla targets land from live sim
       truth with the draws' own derivations (pool clamped 0..100; SLA
       avg/loss mirror draw_sla_gauges's raw math; roster > 8 unfed ->
       the zero-value raw fallback).
detail: The slot table is 16 after the r1 bump (this same file's test asserts len(v.gauges.sla_ms) == 16; Gauges declares sla_ms: [16]Gauge_Ease), but the header comment still names the old cap 8 — misleading about the fallback boundary.
recommended_fix: Update the header to 'roster > 16 unfed' (or drop the number: 'roster beyond the slot table').

title: gauge_wiring_test.odin imports render via ../app/render, deviating from the package's ./render convention
evidence:
app/gauge_wiring_test.odin:22-24 — import "core:testing"
import pp "../core"
import rnd "../app/render"

siblings — app/main.odin:20: import rnd "./render"; app/pullback_test.odin:18: import rnd "./render"; app/noc_toggle_test.odin:20: import rnd "./render"; app/qos_panel_test.odin:9: import rnd "./render"; app/settings_test.odin:14: import rnd "./render"
detail: Every other file in package main imports the render package as "./render"; the new test's "../app/render" resolves to the same package but breaks the package's uniform import style the other five files establish.
recommended_fix: Change the import to `import rnd "./render"` to match every sibling file in the app package.
